identity.origin: Coral Spire of the Pelagic Sanctum (The Shattered Archipelago & Abyssal Shelf)
identity.historical_provenance: Listening to its spiral reveals the rhythmic pulse of oceanic tides. Established during the Sunken Wake Cataclysm (Year 114 AC) by Tide-Oracle Thalassa and the Coral Spire Harpoon Company at Coral Spire of the Pelagic Sanctum.
identity.mechanism_of_action: At 2 Aether, projects the resonant imprint of Coral Spire of the Pelagic Sanctum: Relic. At the start of your turn, restore 1 Vitality to your Leader.
identity.narrative_importance: An enduring artifact of the Coral Spire Harpoon Company, forged during the Sunken Wake Cataclysm and safeguarded by Tide-Oracle Thalassa.
identity.flavor_text: Listening to its spiral reveals the rhythmic pulse of oceanic tides.
identity.collection_biography: At Coral Spire of the Pelagic Sanctum, Living calcified spire rising from the outer reef where harpooners and conchists muster. Conch of the Sunken King draws directly upon that legacy: Listening to its spiral reveals the rhythmic pulse of oceanic tides. Preserved by the Coral Spire Harpoon Company since Year 114 AC, it remains a signature ocean relic tool in Tide-Oracle Thalassa's repertoire.

art.prompt: Rich stylized hand-painted fantasy illustration, tactile painterly brushwork, luminous Aether crystal accents, clear readable silhouette at tabletop card scale, dramatic atmospheric depth, cohesive material rendering. Subject: Spiral mother-of-pearl conch shell resting on wet sand, glowing with blue light. Faction Style (Tidebound — Coral Spire of the Pelagic Sanctum): Scalloped nacre lamellar, hydro-fan blades, twin-pronged coral tridents, and tidal astrolabes, crafted from iridescent mother-of-pearl, living reef-coral, abyssal sea-glass, woven kelp-silk. Silhouette & Pose: Coiled conch shell profile; Suspended or mounted in active Aether resonance. Camera & Composition: Heroic centered object focus on an ornate pedestal with dramatic rim-lighting, vertical 3:4 card illustration framing. Environment & Background: The Sunken Reach in The Shattered Archipelago & Abyssal Shelf (Submerged marble temples, storm-lashed breakwaters, bioluminescent abyssal trenches). Lighting & Color Palette: Warm metallic highlights and gem sheen; dominant colors ocean_sapphire, seafoam_cyan, coral_pearl. Visual Effects & Mood: Subtle Tidebound Aether particles and resonant light motes. Mood: Fluid, mysterious, and surging.
